dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in Bucay Town, Abra Province, Cordillera Administrative Region, Philippines
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20220727PHL** This map illustrates potentially damaged buildings and damaged buildings in Bucay Town, Abra Province, Cordillera Administrative Region, Philippines as detected by Pléiades satellite image acquired on 29 July 2022. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT has identified 6 potentially damaged buildings and 1 damaged building. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
